cohort: 500 pregnant women aged 18-40 underwent thyroid functioning and anti-TPO antibody testing.
finding: One in three antenatal care patients screened for thyroid disorders were diagnosed with SCH, which was linked to complications including increased cesarean section rates and NICU admissions compared to euthyroid women.
mod_finding: Women with subclinical hypothyroidism exhibited a significantly higher rate of cesarean sections.
followup_time: Postpartum period for mothers and immediate post-birth for neonates.
